purpose: Exploratory causal frequency-filtered request-local copy replay; no runtime or speed claim
search: Longest matching suffix with a nonempty confident proposal; back off to shorter suffixes only when no first token qualifies
confidence: Each proposed prefix occurrence count divided by the original matched-suffix occurrence count; censored continuations cannot increase this joint ratio
tie_break: Most recent supporting occurrence among equally frequent next tokens
selection: None. Report unique cycle/wasted-row Pareto points and all grid cells alongside ordinary/ngram/suffix controls
data_scope: Existing three-prompt development-fit trajectories on archived M3 0.5B and Linux CPU 3B operating points only; no validation or reserved held-out data
